description.p: Press Print Screen or Win+Shift+S to take a screenshot of an area, a window, the full screen or a freeform shape, now or after a delay, or to record the screen.
Every screenshot goes to the clipboard and opens in the editor, with a pen, highlighter, arrow, box, text, blur and crop. It saves to Pictures, in Screenshots. Nothing is sent anywhere.
The Scan tab scans paper from a network or USB scanner, from the glass or the feeder, and saves the pages as a PDF or as pictures, or opens them in PDF to sign.
